source.source_date_epoch_provenance: the time release 2.3.5-CE-ubuntu24.04-r4 was cut (2026-11-20T07:51:50Z), by scripts/retarget.py --rev-bump: ReadyStack dates an image by when its release was packaged (owner 2026-11-10), recorded here once and used by every rebuild of the release; it builds upstream commit faecfa2fac61, dated 2026-11-01T03:55:08Z (source.commit_epoch).
source._version_note: Retargeted 2026-10-22 to 2.3.4, the latest GA (GitHub release 2026-10-20). The release tag has NO leading v -- it is `2.3.4`, not `v2.3.4` (see retarget_tag_pattern) -- while the go module path is miniflux.app/v2, so the `/v2` is the module major and not part of the version. go.mod declares `go 1.26.0` with no toolchain directive; the golang:1.26 builder (latest patch) satisfies it under GOTOOLCHAIN=local. No go.work.
source._vendor_note: vendor/ is NOT committed, so the vendor stage runs the standard `go mod tidy -e && go mod vendor`. Deliberately does NOT set source.vendor_committed -- that knob is only correct for trees that ship their own vendor directory.
source._ui_note: There is NO package.json anywhere in the tree. The stylesheets and scripts are committed under internal/ui/static/{css,js,bin} and pulled in by //go:embed at internal/ui/static/static.go. So this is a single-stage Go build with no Node builder at all -- the reason it was picked over authelia and gotify, which both need a frontend stage.

binaries_from_source.name: miniflux
binaries_from_source._note: main package is the repo ROOT (main.go at the top level), not a ./cmd/ subdirectory. Makefile:4 stamps miniflux.app/v2/internal/version.Version and cli.go:109 prints that variable VERBATIM for -version, so the output is the bare `2.3.3` with no surrounding template -- unlike tempo and mimir, which print through prometheus/common/version.Print. Upstream's `make linux-amd64` target also builds with CGO_ENABLED=0, so the static build is upstream's own shipping configuration rather than something imposed here. -buildmode=pie is used only by their native `make miniflux` target and is dropped: it is not in the cross-compiled release build either.
binaries_from_source._commit_note: internal/version/version.go fills Commit from the Go build's vcs.revision (first 8 characters) when no ldflag sets it. Upstream builds in a git checkout, so its `miniflux -info` shows the commit; this build's source has no .git (reproducible from the vendored tree), so the same 8 characters are stamped from source.commit instead of reading 'Unknown (built outside VCS)'. BuildDate stays unset (upstream reads vcs.time) and -info reports it as unknown.
